notes.title: Wigmund - Patch 1.4.6
notes.content:
In this patch we have improved and fixed the following:

[b][b]Misc:[/b][/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug in which switching a craft recipe while working on a another will cause unintended item removal
[*]Decreased the roll chance for bandit chiefs (the Berserkers roll has not been altered)

[/list]

notes.title: Wigmund - Patch 1.4.5
notes.content:
We have improved and fixed the following:

[b][b]Misc:[/b][/b]
[list]
[*]Decreased the dodge/roll chance for some enemies
[*]Fixed a bug in which a teleport from the bear cavern would cause the game progress to freeze
[*]Fixed a bug in which the game's FOV was resetting to the default on each load
[*]Fixed a bug in which the equipment tooltip would not appear when using a controller
[/list]

We present you a new Item: [b]The Spyglass[/b]. After acquiring the magnifying glass, the spyglass can be used to see the resources not only on the minimap, but also on the world map. It can be crafted using the existing magnifying glass and a few more ingredients.

notes.title: Wigmund - Patch 1.4.4
notes.content:
In this patch we have improved and fixed the following:

[b][b]Misc:[/b][/b]
[list]
[*]Increased the size of flying enemies for better hit response
[*]Decreased medicine level required to pick Licorice and Meadowsweet
[*]Craft up to 5 recipes at a time
[*]Improved tooltip item comparison
[*]Fixed an input action queue issue
[/list]

[b]Action queue disable:[/b] We have found a certain issue related to the action queue, that is, if two actions like a roll and a stab are executed almost simultaneously, the roll is being executed and the stab will be automatically executed after the roll. A new option called [b]'Disabled Input Action Queue'[/b] was added, that disables the input action queue. If the queue is disabled an action executed during a roll will NOT be executed at the end of the roll.

[b]Future plans:[/b] For this year we still have two patches planned. Make sure to stay tuned!

Thank you for your feedback and patience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/32d5159ae885658938566182f2c9a11cc693dbb3.png[/img]

notes.title: Wigmund - Patch 1.4.0 Next Project & New Game⁺
notes.content:
Hello!

[h3]Next Title[/h3]
We would be very interested in hearing your opinion about a potential future title. Feel free to drop in to our twitter page and vote in the next project poll.

[h3]Other News[/h3]
In other news, we announce our New Game Plus game mode. You will be able to save a character profile in-game and start a New Game Plus. The 'Impossible+' difficulty level has been tuned to serve the new mode, for those that would like a bit of a challenge. Now go and obliterate those pesky wolves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/6ad64b60183e1adc2aba0f80242aa81f6a7faefc.gif[/img]

[b][b]NG+ Features:[/b][/b]
[list]
[*]If the 'Secret Door' quest is completed, the 'Platinum Box' is kept
[*]If the 'Platinum Box' is owned a stash is added to Wigmund's house
[*]The 'Platinum' is usable only after the objective to meet Raedan is reached
[*]The Magnifying Glass is kept
[*]The Visibility Tablet is kept
[*]The Archaeology Shovel is kept
[*]All quest items are destroyed
[*]The tutorial is not displayed on NG+
[/list]

[b][b]Misc:[/b][/b]
[list]
[*]Increased the resource count (+ added extra spawn points)
[*]Added an action bar lock in options (items are not removable, only replaceable)
[*]Right-Click will be used to sell/store items when a merchant/stash is visible
[*]Recipes/Blueprints can be sold now
[*]Fixed a rare bug in which a fished casket would reward one less item
[*]Fixed an issue in which workbenches were not focus-able on the controller
[*]Fixed an issue when the elevator would not be accessible in the Haunted Basement after a Teleport
[/list]

Thank you for your feedback and patience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/32d5159ae885658938566182f2c9a11cc693dbb3.png[/img]

notes.title: Wigmund - Patch 1.1.0 Archery, Talents and Professions
notes.content:
Hello! 

We gladly announce the release of our new patch 1.1.0. It includes crafting & professions, talents (or perks), new abilities and a new Archer build, featuring ranged combat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/128ed8e86bccd77aa00a01cbd7cea38bf936a050.png[/img]

[b]Professions:[/b]
We have included three professions: Medicine, Crafting and Survival. With Medicine one will be able to craft potions for healing and elixirs that will increase stats for a longer duration. Collecting herbs will play a crucial role in this profession. 

With Crafting one can create some auxiliary armor pieces, item upgrades and jewels for enhancing items and weapons. Collecting animal hides and mining will be very important in crafting. 

And finally with Survival one will be able to fish, hunt and create different gastronomic experiences. And yes... with the proper dwarven fishing pole, one might even fish some treasure.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/432877c5c8f6617ec238994299a73c380953d2ae.gif[/img]

[b]Talents:[/b]
We have added perks with four specializations: two handed sword ("Sword"), sword & shield ("Shield"), bow ("Ranger") and Exorcist for a melee-caster type of build. Vendors will provide re-specialization runes that will reset all points invested in any talents and attributes for a quick in-game re-specialization for players that would like to try out more than one build.

[b]Archery:[/b]
The archery build has made it into Wigmund! It offers the opportunity to engage enemies form a safe(r) distance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/55bc035660236d1f9176a6d41b5224bb09bc440b.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/84716c64a6ff46fa4b070ae424e473d3eff01aa7.png[/img]

We have added two new equipment slots: belt and wrists. And for existing slots we've added some upgrades. Armor kits for helm, plate, legs and enchanted gems for armguards, wrists and belts.

With archery, of course bows also made their way into the game. Some with more emphasis on range, others on damage they will provide a new build opportunity for players less willing to engage in frontal combat.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/60b68f8f98925f020f5c616c8a3f8e52b424a4a9.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/7141e0fdc6b8ce65ecf564f6f755530029f522d3.png[/img]

Some new abilities to reflect the Talent/Perk system have been also added. They include (but are not limited to): a holy shield for Exorcists, a Dagger Storm for Rangers and a Shield Wall for Sword & Shield warriors.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/08f39c9aaaa5eda03442bd879dc5ebbe566aa36d.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/f9e0489114024f5457ff50006456c8be96a5ea85.png[/img]

A player stash is also available, along with the possibility to always teleport in the main map using the Platinum Box.

Improvements & fixes:
[list]
[*] Sprint toggling
[*] Minimap North locking
[*] Monitor selection
[*] User Interface Scale
[*] Fixes (too many to count)
[*] Old save file deletion, since the new content required it
[/list]

We would like to emphasize that all the new content, while it can enhance your capability in combat, is entirely optional and the game can be played as it was before.

We invite you to enter Wigmund's world! 

© 2022 The Scholastics / Wigmund. The Return of the Hidden Knights

notes.title: Wigmund - Release
notes.content:
Hello! 

We announce the release of our full game! The five Chapters of the story are now fully available. This is the final content update. There are over 20 hours of content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/237e5f3e78c745abf8bb5f27856d06ed1e851793.png[/img]

The content includes twelve locations to visit:
[list]
[*] The Hidden Valley
[*] The Wolves Den
[*] Frod Forest - The Open World part
[*] Dracca's Caverns
[*] The Old Iron Mine
[*] The Fort's Dungeon
[*] The Bear's Den
[*] The Goblin's Caverns
[*] Ashdown Castle's Dungeon
[*] Ashdown Castle
[*] The Evil Castle
[*] Burning Heol
[/list]
The open-world maps will feature a full day/night cycle! That is because some quests require night time. Ghost stories are better told in the dark...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/6918e5cc79248f02778eb60563ac6bb1c5d93b03.gif[/img]

Not all the maps are related to the main quest, and you will have the opportunity to also explore secondary dungeons and caverns:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/2acbc14a6ac0c3d0cbace56bdee9c6e226beeeab.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/869ec246a31aa1726e1b3098855c5b08441ffa79.gif[/img]

And deep, terrifying dungeons:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/094fe574f924a14ea1c4cbb723ee62317e3671d3.gif[/img]

You can solve 15 main quests and also 18 secondary quests:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/d81adf340e380e319d26f8a49723a952b2d9909f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/84716c64a6ff46fa4b070ae424e473d3eff01aa7.png[/img]


There are a lot of equipment pieces, including (but not limited to) 9 armor sets, many swords, axes, hammers, shields, artifacts and everything else that a RPG should have:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/9b4a9b21308d57d6dcfa550eee7c2834e9225289.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/7434132465f2d18218325cc1cd447200527542bf.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/128ed8e86bccd77aa00a01cbd7cea38bf936a050.png[/img]

Many enemies will also provide unique and tough challenges for your hero. They will include:
[list]
[*] Trolls
[*] Whelps
[*] Ghosts
[*] Specters
[*] Wizards
[*] Elementals
[*] Imps
[*] Beasts
[*] Werewolves
[/list]
Oh yes, and a few dragon encounters. We have warned you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/380ebe76fca3051195e96609b88dc3a3bfa7030c.gif[/img]

We thank you for your patience, and we invite you to enter Wigmund's world! 

© 2022 The Scholastics / Wigmund. The Return of the Hidden Knights

notes.title: Wigmund - Open World and Controls
notes.content:
Hello! 

[b][b]Open World[/b][/b]
We announce that we're well underway with the outdoor (open-world) environment. The props are coming out quite nicely along with the foliage and environment. When we say open-world we don't mean many interlinked corridors delimited by stones or blockers, but real open-worlds with vast grasslands, meadows and ruins that can be freely explored. Not only that, but it will feature many caverns and dungeons (not necessarily related to the main quest) that can be explored for upgrades and gear.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/94b96db649833310550059a7b4d6eafab36af8a2.gif[/img]

Except the open-world map we are also finalizing another environment, the Eordscraef Caverns:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/cea5dadc6155b166062fbb455a74840411ecd1a9.gif[/img]

The Gedwimor Castle, the evil bastion of pseudo-king Antiochus where Wigmund will meet his final challenge is well underway too. And a fierce dragon fight will also take place during the main quest.

The ETA for the new content is going to be Q2 this year.

[b][b]Controls[/b][/b]
As we have previously stated, our game features an unique type of real-time combat with fast-paced skill (control) based strikes. Each action requires your input and be sure that it will not give you an easy time! But don't worry, there are also difficulty levels for players who are more into the story or exploration part of the game rather than into the combat part.

[b][b]Mouse+Keyboard Controls[/b][/b]
The character's movement is done with 'WASD' keys.

The character can execute four basic strikes, except the rolls, dodges and special attacks. The simple 'Left Mouse Button' click executes a [b]simple strike[/b] that damages a single enemy towards the cursor's direction:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/df3bcf54bbb2dcd777bd4a02e43e16b1c9febebe.gif[/img]

The second basic strike, [b]the stab[/b], is executed by clicking the 'Left Mouse Button' and executing a swift gesture upwards. More powerful than the simple strike it causes extra damage, but at the cost of extra energy:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/6dfdcce76cf9017ba3e61f88b6834d23f1a0bcf0.gif[/img]

The third strike, [b]the swipe[/b], will be executed in the same way as the above hit but by executing a rapid swipe with the mouse in the right or left direction. The character will hit multiple enemies in front of him for less damage:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/73c34946f5794ca2266e6cf48b8629ceee37c498.gif[/img]

The fourth basic strike, [b]the backwards swipe[/b] will be executed like the stab but with a downward mouse direction. It will make the character hit the enemies behind him. Quite useful when employing a hit & run tactic against an overwhelming amount of enemies:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/31e4c8e17ab3ea616f6597090c904fcdfb3def82.gif[/img]

[b][b]The roll[/b][/b] is executed with the 'Space' key while running towards the run direction and  [b][b]the dodge[/b][/b] by the same 'Space' key when standing still:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/6c151f7da39e1a45093d2cb26a2334fac7abd862.gif[/img]

The last defensive action, [b]the block or parry[/b] can be performed by holding the 'Middle Mouse Button':
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/8100f0bff7bce79f7dd4a9394d8804cae0df13db.gif[/img]

The actions (except the swipes) are all rebind-able.

[b][b]Controller Support[/b][/b]
For players who would like to use the controller we tried to map the the above actions to the following controller scheme:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/55571c900b303bb1ef89adba4dae3c6179b9f1bf.png[/img]

In a future content patch, the controller keys will be also be rebind-able.

© 2021 The Scholastics / Wigmund. The Return of the Hidden Knights

notes.title: Wigmund - Major Gameplay Patch
notes.content:
Hello,

Following the gameplay feedback we're made a major overhaul of it following a more usual keyboard+mouse control scheme:
[olist]
[*] 'WASD' is used now for movement
[*] Simple Left Mouse Click is used for attack
[*] Swipe attacks do not require 'CTRL' now. Note, they are optional, one can only use the simple attack
[*] A point & click movement mode can be used if one holds down the 'CTRL' key (but it's optional)
[*] Rolling is based on a simple key and a movement direction and are rebind-able
[*] Blocking/parrying are default on the Right Mouse Button and are rebind-able
[/olist]
We've also fixed some cloth related crashes that affected some users and are well under way with integrating an automatic crash report solution.

For the next week we will iron out all the bugs and issues and once we reach a stable version continue with releasing more content, hopefully releasing the full game this year.

"Wigmund. The Return of the Hidden Knights" is out now! However, keep in mind that it is still an early access and it might have some rough edges here and there. The game should last anywhere between two and five hours, depending on one's skill and chosen difficulty level.

The following features are also missing, but we hope that they will exist in the next patch:

[*] [b][b]Vendors.[/b][/b] Many players will notice that the main character will have in his inventory not just money, but different things that can be bought and sold. In the Early Access version these seem to be useless. But in the full version of the game there will be vendors. So, the player will be able to use the money, to sell and/or to buy things.
[*] [b][b]Open-world outdoors.[/b][/b] Even if the story is clear and some places will become available only if the player will follow the thread of the story in order to solve the quests, for those players who would rather like to explore some nice places the outdoors will be really open world.

notes.title: Wigmund - Final steps before Early Access
notes.content:
Hello! 

We hapily announce that we're very well under way with the preparation for the Early Access. A huge part of this was the finalizing of the features, fixing of bugs and, of course, heavy optimizations for a smooth experience during gameplay. We think that the optimization part is not always provided a high priority, and that is why it was very important for us, since the game-play requires a very smooth combat experience.

That is why for 'Wigmund' we have created a special grid system that enables and disables entities on the fly as they are requested, and volume based instancing areas that automatically merge meshes at runtime into instances in order to reduce draw calls in a certain region.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/248a190a2faaf26bbbf8c67a7c925c4ee02d156d.png[/img]

Without too much ado, here are the results at maximum quality and the PCs specs that ran the game:
1. AMD Phenom X4, 12GB RAM, GTX970: Average 90FPS
2. AMD Athlon 3000G, 4GB RAM, GTX1050: Average 110FPS
3. AMD Rysen 5 4600H, 16GB RAM, GTX1650TI: Average 140FPS

Those are certainly not state-of-the art gaming rigs, and we hope that through those optimizations our game will run smoothly on the widest possible range of hardware.

As for the Early Access content we will have around 3 hours of game-play (probably around 4 for less experienced gamers) containing a part of chapter III. The game will have 5 chapters upon full release. The price will be around 15-19$ for EA and somewhere in the 25-30$ range for the full version. We will plan to release chapter after chapter every 3 months, now that we have all the base systems in place and fixes every week when that will be required. Each release will increase the game's price.

It is very probable that we will not be able to handle localization now, and that we will not be able to support controller (not even partially) but we hope to introduce it with the first content patch.

Aaaaand the release date... Since we still have balancing issues, some bugs, mostly related to the save/load feature we can't be completely certain, but it is very probable that we will have it somewhere in December.

Even better, while the programming part goes on, the props and environments are comming allong quite nicely, having finished more environments for caverns, woods, and villages!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/f704b2436fed3ab7af79ca44a34974ff3b60b3a0.png[/img]

Stay tuned for future updates on our social media and news section!

notes.title: Wigmund - Game mechanics
notes.content:
Hello! 

We've thought to give a small insight to the game's internal mechanics, and especially to the combat mechanics.

[b][b]Combat[/b][/b]
Let's start with the combat. First of all it's real-time and is not selection based. Each action requires your input. Following less threaded paths, the combat gameplay (at least the mouse + keyboard version) basically consists in properly executing mouse gestures that will determine your character to perform certain actions. Those include allowing the character to attack, dodge, roll and block.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/38674361a7da18e639b87e574b3df3e02d9eeb41.gif[/img]

[b][b]Damage[/b][/b]
Once an NPC (or your character) is hit, the body part and impact point is detected based on the weapon's collision. A blow to the head does more damage than a blow equally powerful to the leg. If the body part is unarmored the damage is multiplied by a factor. An arrow or hit to the unarmored head (or body) yields 4x (2x respectively) more damage. Make sure you are always wearing a helmet or that injury might be your last one!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/bb5dce4a462a2ff7662f87736f974879df8ac02c.gif[/img]

[b][b]Damage mitigation[/b][/b]
Armor plays an important part in damage reduction. Plate armor yields more protection but also weights more and weight influences speed. A roll or a dodge will avoid damage altogether. But when you don't have enough room, parrying or blocking decreases damage based on the shield stats and can knock-back enemies. Spells and arrows are only block-able with a shield.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/80a08921cf7e8566a6d926c5f6d0e619f709e8a5.gif[/img]

[b][b]Weight[/b][/b]
The most important aspect of your character's speed is the carried weight. Having a heavy 2H weapon along with a full plate armor will make you slow and even over-encumbered. Wearing a lighter mail armor will make your attacks faster. And weight is important if you want to go for an ultra-heavy armored tank or a fast dps. Weapon weight is more important than the weight of the worn armor. A heavier weapon will slow you down more than a heavy armor.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/eb5c03b7082958130bd91fbda94dde4e8698a965.gif[/img]

[b][b]Energy[/b][/b]
Stamina will increase the quantity of energy that you have. Energy is required for sprinting and maximizing the potential of your hits. Attacking without energy will yield less damage. Rolling and dodging without energy will make them slower.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/40ac75f758ede9f54ba5df9027544f4d52863092.gif[/img]

[b][b]Equipment[/b][/b]
Items don't have a level requirement but used without the proper constitution/agility points they will slow you down and will make combat very difficult and sometimes impossible. Always make sure you are wearing the gear with the proper weight for your character build.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35936665/95e76708a7e9cf3bcdf09bff80d24997a814431d.gif[/img]

[b][b]Specializations[/b][/b]
Our RPG does not contain classes, but you will be able to customize your character to be more prone to tanking, damage or casting. When leveling you will gain different stat points that you can spend on strength, agility etc. They can always be reset for the desired build.

And yes, there's also strength for extra damage, constitution for extra speed and dexterity for extra critical. Note that while the core mechanics are final the numbers and multipliers might not be final, some modifications might occur.

Stay tuned for future updates on our social media and news section.
